pages.text: Every science keeps a drawer of things that should not happen. Physics has defects and law violations, chemistry has molecules that make themselves, biology has cancer, mathematics has monsters. $(thing)Abnormality & Infection$() studies them together, because they behave alike: they $(thing)arise$() from a broken rule, $(thing)replicate$(), $(thing)escape$() what should destroy them, and $(thing)change$() the normal world they live in.

You have met them already. A failing multiblock leaks them: $(thing)Fractured Reality$() spreads block to block like an infection of a higher-dimensional shadow, Nanite Swarms turn their hosts into new swarms, Husks, Void Wraiths, Paradox Echoes and Law Wraiths crawl out. What they leave - $(item)Fractured Essence$(), $(item)Void Essence$(), $(item)Paradox Residue$(), $(item)Nanite Swarms$(), $(item)Law Crystals$() - is the field sample.

Build the $(item)Anomaly Containment Ward$(). It turns each of those drops, with a stabiliser matrix or causal shielding, into sixteen $(item)Contained Anomaly Specimens$() - the raw material of the whole branch. Its Operation console is an epidemic: the specimen grows at β, the ward clears it at γ + q, and R = β/(γ + q) must stay below 1. The faster it grows (just below 1), the more there is to study.

Is it anomalous at all? Normal noise scatters as a Gaussian. A deviation of kσ happens by chance with probability ≈ √(2/π)e^{−k²/2}/k: one in 1.7 million at five sigma - the threshold at which physics believes a discovery. The branch runs in six stages: $(li)Origin$(li)Replication & escape$(li)The systems behind it$(li)Interaction with normality$(li)Extent$(li)Containment, study, isolation - and resolution.
A sample of something that should not be, held in a quarantine field small enough to carry. It is still trying to get out.$(br2)Made in $(item)Anomaly Containment Ward$().
A splinter of reality that broke away from a destabilised creature. It is in several places at once.$(br2)Made in $(item)Chronon Field Inverter$().
What is left of a Void Wraith: a little pocket of nothing that refuses to be filled.$(br2)Made in $(item)Dark Matter Halo Collector$().
What is left after a contradiction resolves itself.$(br2)Made in $(item)Axiomatic Breach Engine$().
A billion machines the size of viruses. Hungry.$(br2)Made in $(item)Nanite Assembler$().
